items.content_html: ESSOS-C Data Viewer: a lightweight web app backed by GeoServer to serve raster and vector layers via OGC (WMS/WFS/WCS). Users can browse maps, toggle styles, and query AOIs for stats (point/zonal/summary). Minimal front end, containerized deploys, reproducible configs, fast rendering, clear APIs, and a small, testable core.
